title: What if we decompose a simple tone? The Chinese remainder theorem and structured Levi graphs in music
summary: While motivated by structural problems in mathematical music theory, this article introduces a novel combinatorial framework that advances the classification of cyclic cubic bipartite graphs. We extend the classical study of Levi graphs by endowing their vertices with an internal algebraic anatomy -- specifically, treating them not as empty geometric nodes, but as defined subsets of a cyclic base space Z_n. This internal structure allows us to formalize and classify a highly restricted class of graph isomorphisms: those strictly induced by global affine bijections f(x) = ax+b (mod n)…
